_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::beams#8, and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The rule holds — point Dirichlet/Neumann conditions on a beam need DNODE-NODE TOPOLOGY — but neither the quoted text 'no design nodes found' nor the quoted file 4C_io_input_file.cpp appears anywhere; both are asserted absent. What 4C actually prints is 'DPoint 1 not in range [0:0[' followed by 'DPoint condition on non existent DPoint?Could not read set from entity type.' from core/fem/src/condition/4C_fem_condition.cpp. Two things in that message mislead: the bracket is the SIZE of the (empty) design-point list, not an ID range the user chose, and the index is zero-based, so a condition written 'E: 2' is reported as DPoint 1. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) on upstream deck beam3r_line2_static_test1.4C.yaml.
expect_in_output: DPoint condition on non existent DPoint?Could not read set from entity type.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: keep the DNODE-NODE TOPOLOGY block. The design points then exist, the second arm exits 0 and the DPoint diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
